# PromptLeo

> > PromptLeo is a comprehensive prompt library offering 100+ curated AI prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, and Midjourney across professional roles and use cases.

PromptLeo provides role-specific prompt templates and examples for developers, marketers, designers, CTOs, project managers, and other professionals. The platform covers both text-based AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral) and image generation tools (Midjourney), with specialized prompts for development tools like Visual Studio Code, PyCharm, and Git.

## Key Topics

- Prompt Engineering
- ChatGPT Prompts
- Claude Prompts
- Mistral Prompts

- AI Image Generation
- Visual Studio Code
- PyCharm
- Marketing Manager Prompts
- Project Management
- Developer Prompts
- Security Engineering
- Brand Identity
- Resource Allocation
- Prompt Writing Guide
